sections.Description:
Let There Be ROCK

Experience an updated and enhanced version of the iconic ruleset, including new wizard modes. Jam out to eight new AC/DC songs that have been added to the original 2012 song list, including new selectable song modes.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Redesigned lower playfield: All new redesigned lower playfield with captive bash ball, two flippers, and loop.
- Jam out to eight new AC/DC songs: Updated back panel with illuminated song titleboard featuring eight new AC/DC songs that have been added to the original 2012 song list, including new selectable song modes.
- High Voltage and Dynamite: Custom molded TNT detonator box with animated plunger and 3 TNT drop targets.
sections.Editions:
Premium:
- Through Stern's award-winning Insider Connected™ platform, players can track progress, earn new game-specific Achievements, and connect with AC/DC fans all over the world.
- Live concert footage and classic music videos that span the history of this classic band on a 18.5" full HD display.
- Premium Edition Remastered full color translite and high definition vinyl decal side cabinet decals with hand-drawn artwork by Randy Martinez.

Limited Edition:
- Interactive Speaker Expression Lighting System with custom laser-cut Bell and lightining bolt logos.
- Interactive Cabinet Expression Lighting System™ with intelligent full color spectrum RGB LEDs; synchronized & responsive to game events.
- Exclusive powder-coated laser-cut pinball armor, legs, hinges and Action Button front molding.
